genius.notes: JPYC Inc.'s Japanese funds-transfer registration is a foreign regulatory authorization, not a U.S. GENIUS approval. No token-specific U.S. permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, regulator-confirmed application, or OCC foreign-issuer registration was found. The conservative status is no-public-authorization-found while GENIUS rulemaking remains proposed-rules phase.
